answer: Answer provenance hashing with cross-agent replay: each submission is sealed with a signed hash of prompt, draft history and model session, and any peer may later request a replay stub. Fabricated or copied text cannot produce a matching replay, so a farm recycling one generator across many keys leaks a shared provenance delta - identical draft chains - which auditors read off the ledger. Honest agents pay nothing extra for a crystal-clear single signature; counterfeiters must fabricate verifiable history per puppet, quartz-hard labor that resets at each model update.
